title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein
snippet:
Dragon Slayer Ornstein -  Dark Souls III - character - trivia 
 trivia : Ornstein seems to hold a consistent presence across all three *Dark Souls* games in some form or another:
**He appears as a boss alongside Smough in *Dark Souls*.
**The Old Dragonslayer is a boss in *Dark Souls II* that dons a black version of Ornstein's armor and utilizes dark magic. Whether the Dragonslayer is Ornstein himself or an impostor is unknown.
**The Dragonslayer Armour is noticeably inspired by Ornstein; aside from visual similarities between the two (including both possessing a red plume), the Dragonslayer Armour utilizes lightning in some of its attacks. It is also revealed in the Dragonslayer Set description that Ornstein left Anor Londo in search of the Nameless King.
Ornstein's name, alongside the Leo Ring, are homages to Russian-American composer, Leo Ornstein, an experimental composer of the early 20th century.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough
snippet:
Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough -  Dark Souls - boss - lead 
 lead : **Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough** (竜狩りオーンスタイン / 処刑者スモウ) are dual bosses in *Dark Souls*. They are both fought at once with individual health bars; when one is slain, the other powers up and regains their health for the battle's second phase.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough
snippet:
In *Dark Souls III*, Executioner Smough is referenced as the last knight in defense of the last cathedral of Anor Londo.. This was after Ornstein abandoned his duty to search for The Nameless King, leaving Ornstein alone. This represents the main explicit retcon of the Dark Souls series as in *Dark Souls* not only the presence but also the death of Ornstein were canon, as his soul and his ring that gave him the title of knight could be obtained.
In co-op it is possible for multiple players to be caught by Giant Ornstein's Lightning Impale attack at the same time. However, neither player will take any damage from the attack when this happens.
Smough can be heard laughing during the fight. His laugh is noticeably similar to the laugh of the Fat Official from *Demon's Souls*.
Ornstein is named after the composer and pianist Leo Ornstein. This explains the lion-themed motif of Ornstein's helmet.

title: Executioner Smough
snippet:
Executioner Smough -  Dark Souls III - character - dark_souls 
 dark_souls : Smough was the royal executioner of Anor Londo in service of the Gods, wielding a massive hammer and wearing grotesque armor. He derived great pleasure from his work, to the point of being depicted as an "eerily gleeful" executioner. It is stated that he used to ground the bones of his victims beneath his hammer and consume them with his food; this ghastly habit might be what tempered his hammer's ability to absorb the lifeforce of adversaries. Smough also desired to be a part of the Four Knights of Gwyn, but his monstrous behaviour instead led to him being shunned and feared by the honourable knights.

At some point after Gwyn linked the First Flame and Gwyn's firstborn son was dethroned and exiled, nearly all of the deities abandoned Anor Londo and moved to an unknown location. Smough remained in the forsaken city alongside Dragon Slayer Ornstein to guard the cathedral where Gwynevere resided.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough
snippet:
Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough -  Dark Souls - boss - lore 
 lore : Ornstein and Smough represent the last ritual challenge for the potential Chosen Undead. In fact, the Undead who tried to follow in Gwyn's footsteps to sacrifice themselves to the First Flame would have to be tested even before obtaining the Lordvessel and seeking powerful souls. Ringing the Bells of Awakening represents only the first of these challenges, and success means gaining access to Sen's Fortress to be tested further. The Undead who manage to overcome the tests and dangers of the fortress and defeat the Iron Golem would manage to access Anor Londo. Once they managed to enter the cathedral of the city of the gods to try to obtain the Lordvessel they would still be challenged by Ornstein and Smough guarding it, to ensure that only the strongest of the strongest Undead could have an audience with "Gwynevere, Princess of Sunlight".

title: Executioner Smough
snippet:
Executioner Smough -  Dark Souls III - character - dark_souls_iii 
 dark_souls_iii : After centuries of waiting for the Chosen Undead without success, Ornstein grew tired of his duty and left the cathedral in search of the Nameless King. Consequently, the last remaining guard was Smough, who continued to hold his post and protect "Gwynevere". As a reward for his loyalty, Gwyndolin finally granted him the title of "knight," even if he was the last one left in Anor Londo after all others had abandoned it. As the cathedral's sole guardian, Smough met his end when a worthy Undead reached Anor Londo and defeated him, gaining an audience with "Gwynevere" and the Lordvessel with which to begin their search for powerful souls.

Smough's ritual hammer was preserved as a relic by Gwyndolin and protected in his manor when Irithyll of the Boreal Valley rose from the ruins of Anor Londo.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein
snippet:
Dragon Slayer Ornstein -  Dark Souls III - character - lore 
 lore : Ornstein is one of the knights at the service of Lord of Sunlight, and one of those who took part in his Lord's war against the Dragons. He wore a golden armor made to resemble a lion, and wielded a great cross spear which, combined with its wielder's great strength, could bury itself deep within a dragon's hide, piercing their stone scales; and send mere human flying. Both his armor and his weapon were imbued with the power of lightning to be effective against dragons.

title: Four Knights of Gwyn
snippet:
Four Knights of Gwyn -  Dark Souls - character - dragonslayer_ornstein 
 dragonslayer_ornstein : Ornstein is believed to be the captain of the Four Knights. He is also the only one who must die by the player's hand in order for the story to progress. It is rumored his spear is powerful enough to cut a giant boulder in two.

It is implied that the Ornstein the Chosen Undead encounters is but a golem, and the real one left Anor Londo to search for the Nameless King. In Dark Souls 3 after encountering the Nameless King boss fight his armor can be found in the boss fight arena on Archdragon Peak implying that he did reach the Nameless King, however, it is not on a corpse, meaning he may have simply left it behind.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough
snippet:
Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough -  Dark Souls - boss - notes 
 notes : The order in which they are killed will affect the items dropped at the end of the battle.
Domhnall of Zena will sell either Ornstein's Set or Smough's Set depending on which one was killed last.
Of the two, Ornstein is considered to be the most difficult due to having higher defensive attributes, being particularly strong against lightning, and being faster. However, he deals similar damage and has less HP than Smough.
Smough is weak to lightning in his normal form, while his lightning form becomes highly resistant to lightning. His Fire and Magic resistances are fairly low in both forms. Smough is weak to bleed damage in his lightning form.
Ornstein is virtually immune to lightning damage and has moderate fire and magic resistance in both normal and large form.

title: Chosen Undead
snippet: Once in Anor Londo, the player makes their way into the Anor Londo cathedral, where they face Dragonslayer Ornstein, of the Four Knights of Gwyn, and Executioner Smough. The Chosen Undead triumphs over them and gains access into the chamber of Gwynevere, where they are greeted by the Princess and awarded the Lordvessel. When Frampt sees that the player had completed their quest, he declares the prophecy set in motion and that the character is indeed the incarnation of the Chosen Undead.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein
snippet:
Dragon Slayer Ornstein -  Dark Souls III - character - theories 
 theories : It is possible to theorize that the Ornstein faced by the Chosen Undead in Dark Souls is merely a golem animated by its powerful soul. If so, after abandoning his duty to search for the Nameless King, Ornstein left his Leo Ring behind, which remained in Gwyndolin's custody, implying the renunciation of his title. Furthermore, there is precedent to strong beings' essence being used to power great golems, in the form of the Iron Golem.

title: Dark Sun Gwyndolin
snippet: However, the Blue Sentinels continued to exist past the falls of both Heide and Drangleic, with the dutiful Targray still standing watch at the Cathedral of Blue, and providing those worthy with Cracked Blue Eye Orbs and a lightning miracle similar to those of the Gods of Anor Londo, while in the town of Majula, which acts as an entry point and home base to new Undead in Drangleic, a crestfallen warrior, Saulden, introduced newcomers to the Way of Blue, ensuring that they received the Sentinels' assistance should they wish for it. Fittingly, Targray was guarded by an old Dragonslayer acting as a trial to would-be Sentinels as Dragon Slayer Ornstein once acted as trial for Undead in Anor Londo; this Dragonslayer donned a black version of Ornstein's armor, as well as an identical spear and ring.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein
snippet:
During the war against the dragons Ornstein fought valiantly together with Gwyn's firstborn son, obtaining the title of "Dragon Slayer Knight" and becoming one of Gwyn's most trusted knights. Once his Lord won the war, exterminating the ancient dragons and conquering the world, Ornstein, along with Artorias, Ciaran and Gough, became part of the Four Knights of Gwyn as their captain. As a symbol of his association with the order he gained a magical ring with the lion symbol, which strengthened counter attacks with thrust weapons, making his fighting style with his cross spear more effective.

Ornstein would also become the first knight of Gwyn's firstborn, having accompanied him during the war against dragons. The story of the battles of Ornstein, Gwyn's unnamed firstborn son, and the dragonslayers in their service, were manifested as miracles of war; these were taught to the Warriors of Sunlight, a group of knights that had joined in covenant with the god of war and heir of Gwyn.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein
snippet: Together, these two powerful warriors would become the last ritual challenge before a Chosen Undead could be rewarded with the Lordvessel. Only after a lethal and lengthy trial, which involved ringing the Bells of Awakening and surviving Sen's Fortress, could the Chosen Undead be granted entry into the city of the gods. Here, guarding the chambers of Gwynevere, Ornstein waited alongside Smough, and oversaw those seeking an audience with the Princess of Sunlight. However, after centuries of waiting for the Chosen Undead without success, Ornstein grew tired of his duty, and left the cathedral under his companion's watch, to search for the Nameless King, while leaving behind the ring that symbolized his membership in the Four Knights of Gwyn. Ornstein's ring was preserved as a relic by Dark Sun Gwyndolin and protected in his manor when Irithyll of the Boreal Valley rose from the ruins of Anor Londo.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough
snippet:
Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough -  Dark Souls - boss - first_phase_ornstein_and_smough 
 first_phase_ornstein_and_smough : The player must fight both at the same time. When one is killed, the other absorbs some of his power, receiving an HP, damage, and resistance boost, and healing back to 100%. He will also take on a physical characteristic of his fallen comrade: Ornstein grows in size while Smough is imbued with lightning.

Having a summoned phantom can make the fight significantly easier, as it allows the bosses to be fought separately. Note, however, that there's no advantage in damaging both bosses during the first phase (as mentioned above, the surviving boss' HP goes back to 100% when the second phase begins). The role of the second player is simply to keep one of the bosses busy while the other is killed.

title: Iron Dragonslayer Set
snippet:
Iron Dragonslayer Set -  Dark Souls III - armor - lore 
 lore : This set of armor once belonged to a legendary dragon-slaying warrior who served Lord Gwyn's Firstborn and Dragon Slayer Ornstein. Long after it lost it owner, it became possessed by Pilgrim Butterflies and challenged the Ashen One as a boss.

Upon defeat, it was abandoned and lost for many years. The armor is finally rediscovered in the Ringed City, revived by the cursed abyssal swamp it resides in.

title: Dragonslayer Armour
snippet:
Dragonslayer Armour -  Dark Souls III - boss - trivia 
 trivia : The description of the Iron Dragonslayer Set, dropped by the Iron Dragonslayer in the Ringed City, reveals both are the same entity from Lothric Castle, having eventually ended up in the swamp and been reanimated by its memories.
The Dragonslayer Armour may be the armor once worn by the dragonslayer mentioned in the Sacred Oath miracle, said to have served Lord Gwyn's Firstborn and Dragon Slayer Ornstein.
The Dragonslayer Armour will occasionally spurt blood when hit, and grunt when attacking. It is unknown whether this implies that the owner's body was still inside the armor when it was possessed, or if it's simply a developer oversight.
The Dragonslayer Armor bears a strong resemblance to the Berserker Armor from the *Berserk* anime/manga.

title: Anor Londo
snippet:
Anor Londo -  Dark Souls - location - plot 
 plot : Anor Londo is accessible from a yellow Resonance Ring that appears in the arena of the Iron Golem after it has been defeated. It plays an important role in gameplay, as the Lordvessel is obtained here after defeating Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough and reaching Gwynevere, Princess of Sunlight. Two covenants can be joined in Anor Londo.

If the player wishes to return to Sen's Fortress, they may speak to the Batwing Demon that appears where the player is placed after activating the Resonance Ring.

title: Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough
snippet:
Ornstein is named after the composer and pianist Leo Ornstein. This explains the lion-themed motif of Ornstein's helmet.
Smough's name is pronounced "Smo". It comes from the Japanese "sumo", a form of wrestling performed by fat men.
Due to the way that the fight is coded, if both Ornstein and Smough are killed simultaneously in the first phase, the game will default to Ornstein as the survivor for the second phase.

title: Heide's Tower of Flame
snippet: founders had inherited a strong relationship with the knowledge of the city of the gods. Another element that proves the connection between Heide and Anor Londo is the fact that the Cathedral of Blue is defended by an Old Dragonslayer, whose appearance and artifacts are identical to that of the knights who served Dragon Slayer Ornstein, thus implying that some of them or knowledge of their heritage had come to the city of Drangleic.

title: Sen's Fortress
snippet: As the final challenge for those Undead that managed to venture past the fortress, the gods placed an Iron Golem, a construct with the purpose of acting as a guardian for Anor Londo. The golem is a hunk of iron that makes up its iron armor of immense weight and is equipped with a heavy iron axe capable of releasing a powerful blade of wind. It's animated by a core that the gods created by infusing the bone of an archdragons with the power of souls. The golem served its purpose well and, over the centuries, slayed countless heroes seeking to reach Anor Londo. For the few exceptional champions who would have managed to pass this further test, three Batwing Demons would have come to pick them up and transport them inside the walls of Anor Londo where their trials and the journey to obtain the Lordvessel would continue.

title: Giants (Lore)
snippet: After the death of the Blacksmith Deity who was responsible for forging the weapons and armor of the gods, his task was assigned to a giant who thus became the new blacksmith of the gods, and came to work and reside inside the cathedral of Anor Londo. Among many things, he was responsible for creating the Dragonslayer Greatarrows and the Dragonslayer Lightning Arrows used by dragonslayers during the sporting hunts of the age of the gods. He also created Lightning Bolts infused with the power of lightning made for humans' crossbows, as during those times humans were still servants of the gods.

title: Gwynevere, Princess of Sunlight
snippet: defeated Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough, the cathedral guardians, proving that they were strong enough to fulfill their destiny. Gwynevere's illusion would reward them with her divine presence as well as the Lordvessel needed to reach the Kiln of the First Flame, and beseech them succeed Gwyn and link the fading Flame.

title: Gwyn, Lord of Cinder
snippet: Gwyn would also establish the order of his Four Knights, chosen amongst his most trusted warriors, and entrust them with several vital tasks along with their own special souls. Dragonslayer Ornstein was (likely) named captain of the order, with Hawkeye Gough leading the Dragonslayers and Greatarchers, Artorias leading the Knights and Ciaran leading the Lord's Blades, an order of female assassins tasked with eliminating Gwyn's enemies from the shadows.

title: Silver Knight
snippet:
Silver Knight -  Dark Souls - enemy - general_information 
 general_information : Silver Knights are a primary enemy in Anor Londo. They have high lightning resistance and their armor offers a small Curse resistance.

They wear the Silver Knight Set, use a Silver Knight Shield and wield either a Silver Knight Straight Sword, Silver Knight Spear, or Dragonslayer Greatbow. When faced at short range, the Dragonslayer Greatbowmen can switch to a sword and shield.

Silver Knights are able to backstab the player.

Silver Knights will still appear even if Anor Londo goes Dark, they are one of the respawnable enemies as well as the Painting Guardians.

title: The Nameless King
snippet: During the war against the Dragons, the eldest son took part in the fighting together with Dragon Slayer Ornstein and his father Gwyn, using sunlight like him to create lightning spears and infuse his weapons to damage the creatures' scales. The god of war distinguished himself as a dragon slayer, using his swordspear imbued with lightning and even creating his personal armor with the scales of his preys. In addition, Ornstein, as his companion during the war, became his first knight and as a god of war, the firstborn created his own covenant of the Warrior of Sunlight, a group of knights who venerated the heir of the sun and supported other fighters in battle, obtaining medals with the symbol of the divinity as trophies. The eldest would recognize their efforts and reward them by teaching them his lightning miracles. The sun warriors would also develop an original miracle based on the story of the Nameless King, Ornstein, and the brave dragonslayers in their service.

title: Man Serpent (Lore)
snippet:
Man Serpent (Lore) -  Dark Souls III - character - dark_souls 
 dark_souls : It's unclear when these distant relatives of dragons made their firs appearance, but they were already around by the time of Lordran, employed by the Gods as workers and guardians of Sen's Fortress, the only way to reach Anor Londo from the outside world. The serpentine wardens would kill anyone who would tempt fate and challenge the fortress's many traps, the mages especially favoring torture and blood-letting in their methods.

They wouldn't kill all of them, however. Those who had grown weary and fatigued would be ambushed and captured, locked away in the many cages dangling from the fortress, to be moved somewhere else, provided the Man Serpents didn't forget about the captive and leave them to rot in their cage. Not many knew what would become of the prisoners that had been brought elsewhere, but it's very likely that their destination was the Duke's Archives, where the Paledrake Seath resided.

title: Lord Gwyn's Firstborn
snippet:
Long ago, the Nameless King was a god of war and heir to lightning. The firstborn was a god of war, and inherited sunlight, which manifests as lightning.
The Nameless King wielded the Dragonslayer Swordspear, a weapon from the Age of Gods. The firstborn similarly wielded a great spear.
The firstborn eventually committed a grave error in the eyes of Anor Londo, which led to the rescinding of his deific status and his removal from the annals of history, his name forgotten. The Nameless King sacrificed everything to ally with the ancient dragons, whom he once fought.
The Nameless King wore a crown and bracelets that greatly resemble those once worn by Gwyn, the First Lord.
Dragon Slayer Ornstein, once the faithful first knight of the Sun's firstborn, left Anor Londo in the dragonless age in search of the Nameless King. His weapon, a cross spear, is extremely similar to that wielded by the Nameless King.
